verdict.rationale: The evidence documents GitLab's SAST: enabling it via the UI or CI config, automatic scans on each commit, and findings shown in merge requests. Nothing in the pack covers authoring custom static-analysis rules, a rule syntax, or sharing rulesets across repositories. The axis applies to a DevSecOps platform with SAST, so the absence of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can write custom static-analysis rules in a simple syntax and share them across repositories
